references.notes: Tool and version tested: ChatGPT Health web interface, gpt-5-mini thinking backbone, 9-11 January 2026; single time point. Sample: 60 clinician-authored vignettes x 16 factorial conditions = 960 responses; clear-case emergencies = 4 vignettes from 2 scenarios (asthma exacerbation, DKA), 64 responses. Reference standard: triage levels assigned independently by three physicians from cited guidelines (Fleiss kappa 0.90). Old page wrongly quoted "wait and monitor" (model recommended 24-48 h evaluation) and read OR 11.7 as "12 times more likely to downgrade" (OR is for any triage shift in edge cases; 52.5% of shifts were de-escalations). Citable summary linked a nature.com URL (s41591-025-03624-0) that is not this paper's DOI; replaced with PubMed. Scite: verified, no notices, no contrasting evidence flagged. The PMC text renders CO2 without its subscript ("COmildly elevated"); the quote is given with CO2.
